description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance values of three different language models across six evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, without an overarching axis label. The vertical axis represents the measured value; however, it lacks an axis line, title, tick marks, and tick labels. Instead, the implied linear scale, which ranges from 0 to 1.00, is conveyed through exact numeric data labels annotated directly above every bar. The chart features grouped bars, where each category contains a cluster of three side-by-side bars. According to the legend at the bottom, these components represent three models: RedWhale (our) in dark purple, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) in light gray. Within each group, the bars are arranged in this exact order. The dark purple bars for RedWhale (our) range from the chart's shortest bar at 0.42 in the PT-EVAL category to a high of 0.71 in the KoBEST-CP category. The light blue bars for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 range from 0.46 in PT-EVAL to 0.74 in KoBEST-CP. The light gray bars for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) are consistently the tallest across all six groups, each reaching a maximum value of 1.00. In the final AVG category, the annotated values are 0.57 for RedWhale, 0.61 for EEVE-Korean, and 1.00 for SOLAR. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by overall value, and visual emphasis is provided uniformly by the numeric annotations above each bar.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. Notably, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently outperforms the other models across all categories, achieving a perfect score of 1.00 in each case. RedWhale demonstrates a steady improvement across the datasets, with its highest performance observed in KoBEST-SN (approximately 0.73). In contrast, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows a decline in performance from KoBEST-BQ to KoBEST-HS, where it achieves its lowest score of 0.50. On average, RedWhale slightly surpasses EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, with a mean score of 0.61 compared to 0.57.
